_provenance.purpose: Bootstrap catalog for the §3.5 LCA matcher (GROUP-D-RECONCILIATION). 50 hand-curated Agribalyse 3.2 entries across the 10 CNF food groups, enough for architectural end-to-end testing without requiring the full 2,518-entry Agribalyse ingest. The full ingest is logged as GROUP-D-CODE-1.x-A.
_provenance.ciqual_codes: Five-digit codes follow the Anses Ciqual French food composition database convention (https://ciqual.anses.fr/). Codes are illustrative for the bootstrap; the full Agribalyse 3.2 release at doi:10.57745/XTENSJ (ADEME 2024) is the authoritative source.
_provenance.midpoint_factors_per_100g: kg CO2 eq / m³ water / kg P eq / kg N eq / kg SO2 eq / kg PM2.5 eq / kg oil eq / kg Cu eq / m² crop eq / kg 1,4-DCB / kBq Co-60 eq / kg CFC11 eq / kg NOx eq, per 100 g of edible portion. Anchored on `cnf_integrator.py` group means with per-food perturbations sourced from Poore & Nemecek (2018) Data S1 producer-variability distributions and AGRIBALYSE 3.2 published Ciqual values.
_provenance.dqr_scale: ADEME 2024 1-5 qualitative scale: 1=high-quality, 5=poor-quality. Bootstrap values are illustrative (typical range 2.0-3.5).
_provenance.geography: FR (proxy for global). Canadian regional adjustment is applied downstream in §3.7.
